claims.evidence: No mechanical, engine-start, or close-up condition footage; witness notes worn tires, not overall condition.
No brand name, logo, or model text is legible in the photo; identity recorded only as generic motorcycle by type.
Report explicitly lists engine condition, mechanical faults, and repair history as not shown.
No registration papers, purchase receipt, or date-stamped documentation in the photo.
No riding clip, brake-lever close-up, or mechanical test shown; report lists brake condition as not shown.
General body visible but no close-up of frame, underside, or chain area to confirm absence of rust.
No chassis/engine number or brand-matching parts photo to confirm originality; brand itself unconfirmed.

risks.risk: True brand/model unconfirmed (seller says Suzuki, witness could not read any logo)
risks.proof: Clear close-up of tank badge, side panel emblem, or engine casing stamp
risks.if_unproven: priced as unbranded/generic motorcycle, not as Suzuki

risks.risk: Engine may not run or have hidden mechanical faults
risks.proof: Video of engine starting and idling, plus test ride clip

risks.risk: Unknown mileage, contradicting '6 months new' claim
risks.proof: Clear photo of odometer/gauge cluster reading
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-mileage/used, not as near-new

risks.risk: No proof of ownership or registration, risk of stolen or unpapered bike
risks.proof: Photo of registration/ownership papers matching chassis number
risks.if_unproven: priced low and flagged, as unverifiable ownership risk

risks.risk: Worn tires may need replacement despite 'good condition' claim
risks.proof: Close-up of tire tread depth on both wheels
risks.if_unproven: priced with tire replacement cost deducted

risks.risk: No chassis/engine number visible to cross-check against papers or theft registries
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverifiable identity, higher fraud risk weighting

proof_requests: Close-up of tank badge/logo confirming brand
Video of engine starting and running
Close-up of tire tread on front and rear wheels
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a motorcycle, so a worst-case price is possible, but brand, mechanical condition, mileage, and ownership are all unverified and must be priced conservatively until proof is supplied.
